field_quirks: The amount field ledger_budget_debit_minus is a debit-minus-credit ledger amount; negative rows are credits/reversals and must not be silently dropped.
company is the department-level organizational dimension (Workday terminology).

Monthly/period spending trends within a fiscal year using fiscal_period or accounting_date.
Chart-ready tables for Pierce County actual-spending trends.
